games.notes: Lakers report not filed yet, Luka Doncic missed Sunday with back tightness and his status is unconfirmed. Hawks without Newell and Gilbert, Landale questionable. A contender against a young Hawks team, should be close.
Jokic, Murray, Gordon and DeRozan all questionable for Denver; Capela out for Houston. Great game if the Nuggets stars suit up, a Houston win if they sit.
Pippen and Stewart out for Memphis; Barnes and Quickley questionable, Kawhi out for Toronto. Two fun, even teams, should be close.
Tobias Harris out, Vassell questionable. Mark Williams out for a Suns team going nowhere. Wemby and the Spurs should win comfortably, but this is a lopsided one.
Butler, Porzingis, Moody and Richard out for Golden State; Pelicans report not filed. Curry still carries a thin Warriors team against a middling Pelicans group, likely a Warriors win.
Haliburton out, McConnell questionable for a struggling Pacers team; Mavs report not filed and Flagg's shoulder status unconfirmed. Watch only for Flagg, otherwise a quiet one.
Anthony Davis questionable for Washington; Duren out for Detroit, Pistons report not filed. A good team against a bad one, likely blowout.
Knueppel, Miller and Schroder out for Charlotte, Jarrett Allen questionable and Merrill out for Cleveland. Mid team against a gutted one, skip it.

tiers: Contenders: Spurs, Thunder, Knicks, Nuggets, Rockets, Lakers. Young & fun: Hawks, Raptors, Mavericks (Flagg), Grizzlies, Pistons.
sources: ESPN scoreboard and injuries, official NBA injury report (12:30 PM ET snapshot), SI preseason title odds
